newsitem.title: SPAIN: Date for Retevision bid announcement not yet set.
newsitem.headline: Date for Retevision bid announcement not yet set.

text.p: Retevision, the future second basic telephone operator in Spain, said on Tuesday that there was still no date set to announce the winning bid in its privatisation.
"The process continues, the committee is meeting every day, but there still has been no date set for the result to be made known," a Retevision spokesman told Reuters.
Although there has been market talk the result would be made public this week, sources close to the talks said an announcement next week could not be ruled out.
After the presentation of offers on June 9, Spain's Development Minister Rafael Arias-Salgado said the winning bid could be announced at the end of June or the beginning of July.
Under the conditions of the tender, the group has two months to evaluate the offers and designate a winner.

The competition is now between two consortiums: a group including Spanish electricity firm Endesa and Italy's Stet which have offered 180 billion pesetas for the stake; and the Opera group comprising Spanish bank BCH, France Telecom and U.S. operator Sprint which have presented an offer of 130 billion pesetas.
While Opera has been outbid financially, it said it could still win on other factors such as infrastructure and the future benefits for the Spanish economy.
